title: Glide Hi-Viz Yellow

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Daytona Glide Hi-Viz Yellow is combines flip-up modular convenience with highway touring comfort, pairing a quick-flip chin bar with certified impact protection. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at a featherweight 1279g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT certifications with an acoustically tuned ~86 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Budget modular with flip-up chin and inner sun visor.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Standard Daytona fit; generally runs true to size with a semi-spherical interior shell. May feel slightly tight on very large heads due to the fixed EPS liner density typical of this price tier.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Daytona Glide Hi-Viz Yellow: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Daytona's Modular lineup, the Glide Hi-Viz Yellow brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT track safety.
story:
The Daytona Glide Hi-Viz Yellow represents Daytona's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Daytona Glide Hi-Viz Yellow delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
